children: Overview
France agricultural consulting firm's H1 2026 revenue rose 2.4% yr/yr
Company's Q2 growth accelerated, driven by rebound in Farming Production
Winfarm expects improved operating profitability and continued deleveraging for full-year 2026
Outlook
Winfarm expects EBITDA growth for full-year 2026
Company anticipates continued deleveraging in 2026
Winfarm sees significant improvement in gross margin and higher EBITDA in H2 2026
Result Drivers

FARMING PRODUCTION REBOUND - Q2 growth was driven by a strong rebound in Farming Production, especially due to international expansion in Asia (notably Singapore, Bangladesh, and the Philippines), which offset declines in the Middle East

OWN-BRAND PRODUCT SALES - Growth in the Farming Supplies division was supported by strong sales of own-brand products, especially at VITAL CONCEPT and EQUIDEOS, and recovery in the Landscape segment via KABELIS
OTHER ACTIVITIES GROWTH - Other activities, including Farming Advisory and Innovation, grew due to the development of the Au Pré! dairy brand and new retail listings
